FINAL IVX SENIOR DEVELOPER CERTIFICATION — COMPLETE ALL REMAINING TASKS

This is the final certification pass before IVX IA Chat is considered production-ready.

Do not add new features.
Do not refactor unrelated code.
Do not change the architecture.
Do not change production data.

Finish only the remaining certification items.

==================================================
1. AUTONOMOUS CODER CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Verify the complete execution path:

Chat Prompt
→ Intent Classification
→ Autonomous Coder
→ Inspect
→ Plan
→ Patch
→ Targeted Tests
→ Typecheck
→ Lint
→ Commit
→ GitHub Verification
→ Deploy (only when requested)
→ Production Verification
→ Complete

Return proof:

- Task ID
- Files changed
- Tests executed
- Typecheck
- Commit SHA
- GitHub verification
- Render deployment ID (if deployed)
- Runtime commit
- /health response
- Total execution time

==================================================
2. TERMINAL STATE FIX
==================================================

Correct the state machine.

A task must NEVER finish FAILED when:

- patch applied
- tests passed
- commit created
- GitHub verified

Only require deployment verification when deployment was explicitly requested.

Acceptance:

CODE_CHANGE (no deploy)
→ COMPLETED

CODE_CHANGE (deploy)
→ COMPLETED after production verification

QA_ONLY
→ COMPLETED

READ_ONLY
→ COMPLETED

DEPLOY_ONLY
→ COMPLETED

==================================================
3. IVX IA CHAT CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Verify every routing path.

Code Change
QA
Read Only
Deployment
Owner Approval
Factory Mode
Module Creation

Every request must route to the proper execution engine.

No deploy-only routing for "find and fix".

==================================================
4. OWNER AUTHENTICATION
==================================================

Run enterprise QA.

Verify:

✓ correct owner login
✓ incorrect password
✓ forgot password
✓ password reset
✓ logout
✓ login again
✓ session persistence
✓ app restart
✓ owner dashboard
✓ admin hub
✓ owner variables
✓ owner permissions
✓ non-owner rejection

==================================================
5. MEMBER AUTHENTICATION
==================================================

Verify:

Members

Investors

Buyers

Realtors

Staff

Password reset

Email verification

Session restore

Logout

Recovery flow

==================================================
6. ENTERPRISE QA
==================================================

Run complete regression.

Authentication

Authorization

Chat

Properties

Deals

Investors

Members

Buyers

Media

Notifications

Documents

Variables

Settings

Admin Hub

Owner Dashboard

Landing Page

Reels

Search

Messages

==================================================
7. CHAT QA
==================================================

Verify:

No duplicate messages

No disappearing messages

Correct ordering

Keyboard

Attachments

Images

Videos

Reconnect

Background

Resume

Pagination

History

Typing

Streaming

Long conversations

==================================================
8. DEPLOYMENT QA
==================================================

Verify:

GitHub HEAD

Render Runtime

Production Commit

Health Endpoint

Commit Match

APK Version

Version Code

Production URL

No deployment mismatch.

==================================================
9. SECURITY QA
==================================================

Verify:

No hardcoded passwords

No service-role key in app

No exposed secrets

No Rork runtime URLs

No Rork SDK

Owner approval required for:

GitHub write

Deploy

APK upload

Factory mode

Safe patch

MFA remains OPTIONAL under:

Settings
→ Security
→ Two-Factor Authentication

Default:

OFF

==================================================
10. PERFORMANCE QA
==================================================

Run:

Memory

CPU

Network

Background

Reconnect

Stress

Regression

==================================================
11. FINAL EVIDENCE
==================================================

Return ONLY verified evidence.

Repository

Branch

Commit SHA

Render Deploy ID

Runtime SHA

APK Version

APK Download URL

Health Response

Tests Passed

Tests Failed

Typecheck

Production Verification

==================================================
12. FINAL CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Mark COMPLETE only if ALL pass.

Return:

AUTONOMOUS CODER:
PASS / FAIL

IVX IA CHAT:
PASS / FAIL

OWNER AUTH:
PASS / FAIL

MEMBER AUTH:
PASS / FAIL

CHAT:
PASS / FAIL

ENTERPRISE QA:
PASS / FAIL

DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / FAIL

SECURITY:
PASS / FAIL

APK:
PASS / FAIL

PRODUCTION:
PASS / FAIL

FINAL STATUS:

CERTIFIED FOR PRODUCTION

or

NOT CERTIFIED

For every FAIL item, provide:

- exact blocker
- affected file(s)
- root cause
- corrective action
- estimated completion

Do not report COMPLETE unless every PASS is supported by live evidence.
